newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close low on retail sales.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close low on retail sales.

text.p: Sri Lankan stocks closed soft on Tuesday on sales by small investors seeking liquidity ahead of public offers and low foreign participation, brokers said.
The all-share index closed 2.2 points down at 846.2. Price declines outnumbered gains by 41 to 20. Hayleys fell 12.50 rupees to 275, John Keells Holdings fell five to 360.
"Small investors are getting liquid to take positions in plantations and the NDB (National Development Bank )," said Dimuthu Abeysekera of Allied Phillips securities.
The government has said it will make public issues in September of plantation firms.
